_comment: Modules whose root carries no legal file under hack/credits' filename policy.
Each entry vendors the license text that applies, with its source, so CREDITS stays complete.
An entry for a module that now ships a legal file, or whose text file is missing, fails the run.

github.com/mattn/go-localereader.source: README.md of the module declares the MIT license and the author; the module ships no LICENSE file

github.com/minio/colorjson.copyright: Copyright (c) 2010 The Go Authors (the module is a modified copy of Go standard library code; every source file carries the Go Authors copyright header)
github.com/minio/colorjson.source: module ships no LICENSE file; the Go BSD-3-Clause license text applies per the file headers
